title: ANTLR
description: ANTLR — Any-Language Compiler Factory (public edition). Real documented tool; god-mode caveat applies.
body: ANTLR is a real, publicly documented software tool relevant to Any-Language Compiler Factory. Terence Parr's parser generator that reads grammar files and produces lexers, parsers, and tree walkers in many target languages. In the context of the god-mode vision, it represents the current real-world state of the art for part of what "Any-Language Compiler Factory" aspires to do: Generates language-specific compilers, interpreters, parsers, and development tooling from formal language definitions.. Its documented capabilities include scaffold generation and multi-target code emission, and it is used in production or research settings today.
